workload: two simultaneous Windows builds versus one verified Swarm build

protocol.cache: fresh Swarm action key in each arm
protocol.receiver: Two fresh HTTP GETs on Linux loopback, verified Radar health and linked CSS; host counters read on that same sample.
protocol.workstation: Fresh Radar health GET through an existing authenticated SSH forward; SSH setup is outside the measurement.
protocol.timing: Sampling begins before the compiler. Requests must start and end within every compiler window and the scene. Total job time includes admission, transfer and receipt verification.
protocol.timing_alignment: Smallest of three starting and two ending round trips bound monotonic-clock offsets. A 500 ppm margin covers drift during observation.
protocol.storage: Each device reports its last counter minus its first within the measured interval. Counters include other host activity. The disk and partition overlap.
protocol.service_budget_scope: Experimental thresholds for this single-user measurement; both endpoints, each arm and each pair are evaluated.

independent_check.scope: Two requests per site, one compiler per site, actual matching input/output, both sample windows, RAM, load, temperature and latency.
